name: Nested storage drilldown
command: for p in '/System/Volumes/Data/Library/Application Support' /System/Volumes/Data/Library/Developer /System/Volumes/Data/Library/Updates /System/Volumes/Data/private/var /System/Volumes/Data/private/var/tmp /System/Volumes/Data/opt/homebrew/Cellar /System/Volumes/Data/opt/homebrew/var '/System/Volumes/Data/macOS Install Data/UpdateBundle' /System/Volumes/Data/private/var/vm; do printf '\n--- %s ---\n' "$p"; du -x -k -d1 "$p" 2>&1 | sort -nr; done
